caption: The drawing depicts an outdoor scene with a blue background and features several figures and animals beneath two large trees with green and red leaves. There are four human figures, all dressed in light-colored clothing and brown hats, situated toward the center and right of the image. One figure on the left stands beside a light-colored horse, holding its reins. To the right, two figures are standing, while two others are sitting or crouching on the ground, one of them holding a long stick. There are three dogs, positioned in front of and beside the people. The ground is depicted with multicolored areas of brown, blue, and green, and the overall composition centers the human figures and animals in a natural setting with stylized trees above and around them.
